title: Design Bus Seat Booking System
statement: The task is to design a bus booking class over n rows of seats A-D (up to 10^5 calls) supporting toggling a seat, the total booking time in toggle order (a window seat costs 3, not 1, if its adjacent middle seat was already booked), and the minimum total over all orders. A hash map of frozen per-seat costs keeps a running sum; the minimum is the booked-seat count.
